objective.statement: Automate the @crispykitchen TikTok reels operating system: ideate from cooking trends, draft scripts and storyboards, produce short videos with CapCut and approved stock B-roll, schedule or post through Buffer/TikTok on a regular cadence, monitor 48-hour performance, and double down on themes that grow the account toward 50k followers and 5% engagement within 90 days.
success: Publish 1 to 2 TikTok reels per day on @crispykitchen for the 90-day campaign window.
Reach 50,000 TikTok followers on @crispykitchen by day 90.
Maintain at least 5% average engagement rate across published reels during the campaign.
Every published reel has a logged source file, final video file, caption, hashtag set, TikTok post URL, and 48-hour metrics record.
Each reel is watched for the first 48 hours after posting and assigned a double-down, iterate, or cut recommendation.
Themes with 3 consecutive reels under 1,000 views are stopped and marked inactive before more videos are produced from that theme.
failure: The account goes dark with no TikTok reel posted for 3 or more consecutive days.
A reel is posted that is off-brand against the @crispykitchen brand guidelines document.
A reel is posted without both a caption and hashtags.
A reel is posted during the first 2 weeks or within the first 10 videos without explicit owner approval.
A brand-risky reel is posted after the initial approval period without owner approval.
A theme continues producing reels after 3 consecutive published reels from that theme receive fewer than 1,000 views at the 48-hour mark.
constraints: Use only the owner's TikTok account @crispykitchen, Buffer scheduler, CapCut editor, stock B-roll library, and brand guidelines document.
No paid ads, boosted posts, influencer payments, or other paid distribution.
Never post a reel without a completed caption and hashtag set.
Owner must approve every video before posting for the first 2 weeks and for at least the first 10 videos.
After the initial approval period, auto-posting is allowed only for reels that pass brand-safety checks and are not brand-risky.
All brand-risky, ambiguous, controversial, or off-guideline content must be escalated to the owner before scheduling or posting.

dispatcher.profile: CEO dispatcher coordinates the @crispykitchen content board, assigns ideation, production, approval, scheduling, posting, and performance-analysis work to specialist workers, and enforces owner approval and side-effect boundaries before any external action.

profiles.ceo: Owns campaign strategy, interprets owner boundaries, prioritizes themes, approves workstream sequencing, and escalates policy or brand-risk decisions.
profiles.optimizer: Analyzes 48-hour TikTok metrics, tunes safe campaign knobs within bounds, recommends double-down/cut decisions, and adjusts cadence, theme allocation, hashtag mix size, and production batch size.
profiles.worker: Executes assigned content operations: trend review, script and storyboard drafting, CapCut production preparation, Buffer scheduling preparation, TikTok posting preparation, proof logging, and metric collection.

data_access_rules: Read TikTok performance data only for @crispykitchen.
Use the brand guidelines document as the source of truth for brand fit and risk checks.
Use stock B-roll only from the allowed stock B-roll library.
Do not use paid distribution, paid promotion, or paid creator collaborations.
posting_rules: No TikTok post may be published without a final video file, caption, and hashtags.
Owner approval is required before posting every reel during the first 2 weeks and until 10 videos have been approved.
After the first 2 weeks and first 10 approvals, non-brand-risky reels may proceed only if they pass the brand guidelines check.
Brand-risky reels must be held for owner review.

capabilities: Map trend formats to @crispykitchen brand-safe cooking themes
Assemble short video assets in CapCut
Verify caption and hashtags before posting
Detect themes with 3 consecutive reels under 1,000 views
Recommend double-down, iterate, or cut decisions

workstreams.description: Convert TikTok cooking trends into @crispykitchen-safe reel themes and concept backlogs.
Produce scripts, storyboards, captions, and hashtag sets for approved reel concepts.
Create final short video files using CapCut and the allowed stock B-roll library.
Route videos through owner approval or auto-clearance, then schedule via Buffer or publish to @crispykitchen TikTok.
Monitor each reel for 48 hours, log metrics, stop weak themes, and double down on winners.

stages.description: Identify cooking trend opportunities and convert them into brand-safe @crispykitchen reel concepts.

triggers.detail: Daily ideation pass to maintain enough concepts for 1 to 2 reels per day.
Trigger additional ideation when scheduled-ready backlog is too low.

actions.description: Review TikTok cooking trend formats relevant to @crispykitchen.
Create theme candidates that fit the cooking account and brand guidelines.
Remove concepts requiring paid ads, paid creators, off-brand positioning, or unapproved systems.

criteria: At least 4 active brand-safe reel concepts are available or all viable trends have been reviewed.
Each concept includes theme, hook, recipe or cooking angle, trend rationale, and brand-fit rationale.
No concept requires paid ads or unapproved external systems.

stages.description: Turn approved concepts into complete production packets.

triggers.detail: Begin drafting when a concept moves from candidate to approved for production.
Draft more packets when production-ready scripts are below cadence needs.

actions.description: Write a concise cooking reel script with hook, steps, payoff, and timing.
Create shot-by-shot storyboard with required B-roll or CapCut edit notes.
Write caption and hashtag set; mark the reel incomplete if either is missing.
Compare script, storyboard, caption, and hashtags against the @crispykitchen brand guidelines document.

criteria: Script, storyboard, caption, and hashtags are complete.
Brand guidelines check is passed or the reel is flagged brand-risky for owner review.
The production packet references only approved systems and approved stock B-roll sources.

stages.description: Produce the final reel video file in CapCut using approved assets.

triggers.detail: Start editing when a production packet is complete.

actions.description: Build the reel in CapCut using the storyboard, script, and approved stock B-roll.
Export a final short video file suitable for TikTok posting.
Check that the final file matches the approved concept, script, caption, and hashtags.

criteria: Final reel file exists and is linked in the reel record.
CapCut project reference is logged.
Source B-roll assets are from the allowed stock B-roll library.
Final video has passed brand-safe visual review or is flagged brand-risky.

stages.description: Determine whether a reel needs owner approval or may auto-clear after the initial approval period.

triggers.detail: Approval routing starts when a final video file is ready.
Owner may manually request review of any reel before scheduling or posting.

actions.description: Require owner approval if the campaign is within the first 2 weeks or fewer than 10 videos have been approved.
Classify the reel as brand-safe or brand-risky using the brand guidelines document.
Send the reel file, caption, hashtags, storyboard, and brand-risk notes to the owner for approval when required.
Record explicit owner approval or auto-clearance basis before scheduling or posting.

criteria: If within the first 2 weeks or first 10 videos, explicit owner approval is recorded.
If after the initial approval period, auto-clearance is recorded only for non-brand-risky reels.
Brand-risky reels remain blocked until owner approval is recorded.
Caption and hashtags are present before moving to scheduling.
evidence_required: owner approval record or auto-clearance record

stages.description: Schedule approved or auto-cleared reels in Buffer and publish to @crispykitchen TikTok on the 1 to 2 reels/day cadence.

triggers.detail: Scheduling starts when approval or auto-clearance is complete.
Posting cadence check to keep @crispykitchen at 1 to 2 reels per day.

actions.description: Block scheduling and posting unless final file, caption, hashtags, and required approval or auto-clearance are present.
Create or update a Buffer scheduled post for the approved @crispykitchen reel.
Publish the approved reel to TikTok account @crispykitchen and capture the post URL.
Record the TikTok post URL, posting time, caption, hashtags, final file, and theme.

criteria: A reel is scheduled or published only after approval or valid auto-clearance.
Published reel includes caption and hashtags.
TikTok post URL is captured for every published reel.
Daily cadence remains within 1 to 2 reels unless owner intervenes.

stages.description: Collect 48-hour performance metrics for every published reel and classify the result.

triggers.detail: Start metric watch when a reel is published.
Collect the required 48-hour TikTok performance snapshot.

actions.description: Read views, likes, comments, shares, saves if available, followers gained if available, and engagement rate for the reel.
Attach the 48-hour metrics snapshot to the reel proof log.
Classify reel as double-down, iterate, or underperforming using views, engagement, and theme streak.

criteria: 48-hour metrics are logged for the reel.
Engagement rate is calculated.
Theme performance streak is updated.
A double-down, iterate, or cut recommendation is recorded.

stages.description: Reallocate production based on performance and stop weak themes.

triggers.detail: Stop a theme when it has 3 consecutive reels below 1,000 views at 48 hours.
Prioritize themes when engagement rate exceeds the campaign target.

actions.description: Mark theme inactive when it has 3 consecutive reels under 1,000 views.
Create additional concept slots for themes with strong 48-hour performance.
Adjust future production mix toward winners and away from weak themes within safe tunable bounds.

criteria: Themes with 3 consecutive sub-1,000-view reels are marked inactive.
Winning themes have additional concept slots assigned.
Production allocation changes are logged with rationale.
No stopped theme is used for new reel production unless the owner manually reactivates it.

triggers.detail: When a reel is published, begin the 48-hour performance watch.
Collect performance metrics 48 hours after publication.

stop_conditions: 48-hour metrics have been logged and classified.
The reel has been cut or archived because it is unusable, rejected, or off-brand.

triggers.detail: Stop the theme if 3 consecutive reels from the theme are below 1,000 views at 48 hours.
Promote the theme when engagement reaches or exceeds the 5% target.

stop_conditions: Theme is marked inactive after 3 consecutive sub-1,000-view reels.

triggers.detail: Owner replies with approval, requested changes, or rejection.
Follow up on pending owner approvals so cadence does not go dark.

stop_conditions: Owner requests changes and the reel returns to editing.
Approval expires before the scheduled posting window and the reel is not posted.

triggers.detail: Daily campaign health check for cadence, follower growth, engagement, and backlog.
Escalate when the account risks going dark for 3 consecutive days.
Mark campaign goal reached when @crispykitchen reaches 50,000 followers.

stop_conditions: Campaign reaches day 90 and is completed.
Campaign fails due to going dark 3 or more consecutive days or repeated boundary violations.

owner_boundaries: External reversible actions, including Buffer scheduling and owner approval messages, require the applicable approval gate before execution.
External irreversible actions, including publishing to TikTok @crispykitchen, require approval or valid auto-clearance and must pass the caption, hashtag, and final-file gate.
Financial side effects are forbidden because the owner specified no paid ads.
No reel may be posted without caption and hashtags.
Owner approval is mandatory for all videos before posting for the first 2 weeks and first 10 approved videos.
Brand-risky reels always require owner approval before scheduling or posting.

escalation_paths.condition: A reel is classified as brand-risky, ambiguous, controversial, or potentially off-brand.
The account has 2 consecutive days without a scheduled or published reel and risks going dark for 3 days.
Caption or hashtags are missing from a reel queued for scheduling or posting.
A theme hits 3 consecutive reels under 1,000 views at 48 hours.
Any workflow step would require paid ads, paid promotion, or unapproved external systems.
Owner approval is required but not received before the posting window.

daily_reel_target.controls: How many @crispykitchen reels the system aims to publish per day while staying within the owner-specified cadence.

approval_followup_cadence_hours.controls: How often the system follows up on pending owner approvals during approval-required periods.

minimum_ready_reel_backlog_count.controls: How many approved or near-ready reels should be kept in the backlog to avoid going dark.

hashtag_count.controls: Number of hashtags generated per reel caption package.

theme_double_down_engagement_threshold_p.controls: Engagement-rate threshold used to recommend producing more reels from a theme.

winning_theme_production_share_percent.controls: Share of future production slots allocated to themes that outperform the engagement target.

production_batch_size.controls: Number of scripts or videos prepared together in one production batch.

owner_summary.summary: Hermes will run a 90-day @crispykitchen TikTok reels engine using TikTok, Buffer, CapCut, the stock B-roll library, and the brand guidelines document. It will target 1 to 2 reels per day, 50k followers, and 5% engagement. Every reel will include a final file, caption, hashtags, approval or auto-clearance proof, post URL, and 48-hour metrics. Owner approval is required for every video during the first 2 weeks and first 10 videos, and always for brand-risky reels. No paid ads or financial side effects are allowed. Themes with 3 consecutive reels below 1,000 views at 48 hours will be stopped.
